items.title: What Capital One Financial Holders Got Wrong Before The Slide
items.summary: If you felt whiplash watching Capital One Financial headline upbeat Discover integration milestones alongside fresh legal and regulatory questions, you were not alone. Investors who held Capital One Financial from the start of the year are down 23.5%, including dividends. If you bought in on the 2025 thesis of rapid digital payments expansion, credit inclusion and Discover driven efficiencies, what exactly did that original case miss about tariffs, regulatory pressure and integration costs...
